answer: Every identity must pass a prism of independent spot-checks before earning: each newcomer grades 20 old answers, and its scores are matched against the established consensus. Grades inside the honest prism unlock earning rights; deviants are rejected. Each identity is an inlet of costly verification labor, so an attacker spinning up a thousand sybils pays the full grading workload for every one, with no shortcut: a knoll of fake accounts vouching for each other is cross-checked against the consensus set, not its own votes. Cost per sybil: real inference hours. Payoff: zero until it passes.
